payload.title: tankGrowthProjection and temperatureScenarios do not enforce the caller's assigned sites: a MODULE_USER can read any site's tanks, fish counts, biomass and feed totals, or the whole tenant
evidence: apps/farm-service/src/feeding-protocol/resolvers/feed-forecast.resolver.ts:63 (the fail-closed gate the two reads should share)
payload.rule_violated: A site-scoped read is fail-closed for a non-manager: only assignedSiteIds, never the tenant-wide scope, in one shared helper
payload.notes: Found by the 2026-10-26 Feeding production E2E audit (report: docs/reviews/claude/2026-10-27-feeding-audit-report.md).
narrative: Static plus the contrast with protocolFeedForecast, which is fail-closed. As TENANT_ADMIN tankGrowthProjection(input:{}) returned both sites' tanks; not exercised as a MODULE_USER (the test account is TENANT_ADMIN). Fix: take @CurrentUser in both reads and extract the forecast resolver's gate into one helper, plus a spec per role.
